messages:
support: alert for @devex — customer OptiForms (acct: opti-314) reporting duplicate invoices after calling /v1/generate. They see intermittent 500 responses and the TS SDK retried 3x, billing shows charged for each attempt. attaching customer's minimal repro and logs.

maya (support): thanks, pulling logs now. I see errors at 2025-06-15T14:02:11Z..14:02:13Z. Payloads identical, client retried immediately. customer is using ts-sdk@1.2.0 default retry policy. repro snippet they pasted: 
```js
// customer repro (node)
const { Redwood } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.text.generate({ model: 'gptx-2', input: 'hello' });
```

maya (support): they did not set an idempotency header. logs attached show request ids.

sam (devex): quick thought — different SDKs have historically handled idempotency headers differently. python SDK auto-sets an Idempotency-Key for non-streaming generate calls; TS/Go relied on spec annotations during client gen. if the OpenAPI change removed that hint, TS generator may have stopped adding the header behavior.

omar (eng-runtime): pulled server logs for req ids provided. snippets: 
```
2025-06-15T14:02:11.012Z req=opt-req-9f3 status=500 err=internal_error
2025-06-15T14:02:11.213Z req=opt-req-9f3 retry=1 status=500 err=internal_error
2025-06-15T14:02:11.415Z req=opt-req-9f3 retry=2 status=200 tokens=142
```
omar (eng-runtime): server returned 500 twice then finally 200. backend currently counts tokens per successful response. because each retry eventually succeeded, customer charged for the last success but retries generated partial upstream work that the billing pipeline also picked up. we need to dedupe or stop double-charge for retry attempts.

helena (billing): noted. I created a billing investigation and will need the full list of request ids and client timestamps to evaluate refunds. For customers we proactively refund when duplicates are clearly retry-related.

maya (support): quick repro locally: python sdk v1.3.0 shows Idempotency-Key header present, ts-sdk@1.2.0 does NOT. Example captured headers: 
```
Python request headers:
Idempotency-Key: 2f1b...
X-Request-Id: opt-req-9f3

TS request headers:
X-Request-Id: opt-req-9f3
(no Idempotency-Key)
```

sam (devex): that matches a cross-sdk mismatch. This looks like a generator/CI-drfit issue — our OpenAPI spec used to include a vendor extension x-idempotency: true on /text/generate which the generator mapped to auto-header behavior. I checked the spec published on 2025-06-14 and the extension is missing. the generator CI job didn't fail because the regen pipeline only runs on tag changes for "sdk-surface" and that spec change was published without updating the tag.

alex (releases): remediation path: 1) regen TS and Go clients from current spec (or better, restore x-idempotency in spec), 2) cut patch releases (ts 1.2.1, go 0.9.3), 3) add an integration test in sdk-integration that asserts Idempotency-Key is present for generate endpoints, 4) add CI gate to detect vendor-extension removal. how fast can devex do regen + test?

sam (devex): I can run regen now, but we need a spec decision — either restore the vendor extension or make generator infer idempotency for non-streaming text endpoints. prefer explicit spec so it's durable. I'll open a PR to the spec repo to re-add x-idempotency and then trigger regen. estimated: regen + smoke tests 6-8 hours, patch releases within 24-48h.

maya (support): mitigation for affected customer: set their TS client's retryPolicy to no-retry and enable client side backoff: 
```js
// temp mitigation
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 0 } });
```

omar (eng-runtime): server-side durable mitigation: we can use X-Request-Id + request body hash dedupe in the ingress for 1 minute window so retries don't cause duplicate billing. I'll coordinate a short-lived rule.

helena (billing): created BILL-2379 and flagged OptiForms for refund evaluation. please add full request id list to the ticket.

infra-bot: Monitor alert created: #INC-2025-184 (autogenerated) :eyes:

sam (devex): summary / action items:
- spec: re-add x-idempotency on /text/generate (PR opened)
- regen: regen TS/Go/Py clients off updated spec and publish patch versions
- CI: add integration test asserting Idempotency-Key behavior and gate on vendor-extensions (prevent silent spec drift)
- runtime: implement temporary dedupe by X-Request-Id for 60s window
- support/billing: apply customer mitigation and evaluate refunds (BILL-2379)

sam (devex): ETA: PR + regen start today, patch releases within 48h. tagging @alex (releases) @helena (billing) @omar (eng-runtime). :thumbsup:

maya (support): noted, I'll update the customer with mitigation steps and timeline.

alex (releases): ack, will reserve release slot and prioritize the TS patch.

helena (billing): ack, will update BILL-2379 with request ids when available.

support: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth.
